Getting started

How an estimate works

1

Tell us about the project

Send the form below, email, or call directly with what you have in mind.

2

We go over the scope

We follow up to talk through the work, and visit the site when it helps to see it in person.

3

You get a written estimate

Pricing and scope are laid out clearly before any work is scheduled.

4

We schedule the work

Once you approve the estimate, we book the job and keep you posted as it moves along.

Services

What Patterson Construction does

The full list below reflects Patterson Construction's published service offering for the Kingston, Gananoque, and Brockville area.

Interior Renovations

  • Kitchen renovations
  • Bathroom renovations
  • Drywall installation and repair
  • Flooring — tile, hardwood, laminate
  • Trim and casing
  • Complete top-to-bottom renovations

Exterior Renovations

  • Siding — commercial and residential
  • Exterior insulation
  • Sheeting and framing
  • Basic landscaping
  • Windows and doors
  • Custom-built decks and sheds
  • Fences
  • Foundation repairs

Siding

Siding is one of Patterson's core trades, covering both residential homes and commercial buildings, done alongside exterior insulation and sheeting so the whole wall assembly is handled by one crew.

Steel Roofing

  • Rip and removal through sheeting and strapping
  • Specializes in steel shingles
  • Installs major brands: Ideal, Vic-West, Havelock, and Agway
  • All profile types
  • All underlays and trims

About

About Patterson Construction

Patterson Construction is a team of tradespeople serving the Kingston, Gananoque, and Brockville area. The crew works across interior renovations, exterior renovations, siding, and steel roofing — from a single repair to a complete top-to-bottom renovation.

Every project is scoped to the budget the customer brings, with the same approach whether the job is small or large: clear communication, tidy work, and a schedule that's kept.

Completed work is backed by a limited warranty — ask for the specifics when you request your estimate.

  • Serving Kingston, Gananoque, Brockville, and the surrounding area.
  • Interior renovations, exterior renovations, siding, and steel roofing.
  • Reach Larry or Erin Patterson directly — see the Contact page.
